gateway_config:
# XID-10 gate: agentgateway as the deputy under test (RFC 8693 IMPERSONATION).
#
# Everything is loopback-only. agentgateway binds all interfaces by default, so
# every listener (gateway, admin, stats, readiness) is pinned to 127.0.0.1.
#   client --(user JWT)--> agentgateway :3790
#   agentgateway --(token exchange)--> local_as :8790/token
#   agentgateway --(exchanged token)--> recording upstream :18790/mcp
config:
  adminAddr: 127.0.0.1:15790
  statsAddr: "off"
  readinessAddr: "off"
gateways:
  xid10:
    port: 3790
    bindAddress: 127.0.0.1
routes:
- name: xid10-mcp
  gateways: xid10
  policies:
    # Inbound: only users of the local AS, audience agentgateway-api.
    jwtAuth:
      mode: strict
      providers:
      - issuer: https://local-as.test
        audiences: [agentgateway-api]
        jwks:
          url: http://127.0.0.1:8790/jwks
  backends:
  - mcp:
      statefulMode: stateful
      targets:
      - name: upstream
        mcp:
          host: http://127.0.0.1:18790/mcp
        policies:
          backendAuth:
            oauthTokenExchange:
              host: 127.0.0.1:8790
              path: /token
              # The validated inbound user JWT is the subject token (jwtAuth
              # strips the Authorization header unless preserveToken is set).
              subjectToken:
                source:
                  expression: jwt.rawToken.unredacted()
                tokenType: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
              # Impersonation: no actorToken, so the exchange carries no actor
              # and the exchanged token has no `act` claim.
              audiences: [https://upstream.test/mcp]
              scopes: [read:notes]
authorization_note: inbound users validated by jwtAuth against the local AS JWKS; no gateway-side RBAC configured
actor_source: none (no actor token sent or configured)
summary: LEAK: delegation integrity failed (actor_present) between 'A' and 'B' — impersonation: the exchanged token carries no acting-agent ('act') claim, so the agent acting for the user is invisible.
